levels.name: SOURCE_ROUTE_DEFINED
levels.meaning: An official/public or licensed route is identified and executable.

levels.name: PUBLIC_BOOTSTRAP_COLLECTED
levels.meaning: Raw public files were downloaded and hashed. No edge claim.

levels.name: POINT_IN_TIME_DATA_ADMITTED
levels.meaning: Forecast-local availability, lifecycle, revisions and outcome isolation passed.

levels.name: HISTORICAL_BLIND_PROOF
levels.meaning: Frozen model beat baselines on sealed outcomes after trial correction and real cost modelling.

levels.name: LIMITED_PRODUCTION_READY
levels.meaning: Shadow and small-capital fills passed exact-scope risk gates.

levels.name: FULLY_TRADING_READY
levels.meaning: Prospective PF, drawdown, calibration, capacity and extreme-winner gates passed.

rule: No lower level may be renamed as a higher level.
